title: Beyond K/V Caches: Cross-Model State Handoff in Hybrid Linear-Attention LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.08133v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Production deployments often use different models to balance cost and quality through cascading, routing, and switching models during long conversations. Context accumulates across turns. Each switch requires the target to repeat prefill over this context. Existing methods transfer full-attention (FA) K/V caches across models. Hybrid linear-attention models also retain recurrent states (REC) and convolution histories (Conv). The interaction between Conv and REC complicates cross-model state transfer. Conv perturbations can change keys and values in recurrent layers and alter REC updates. Conv histories are overwritten, but changes in REC can still affect later outputs. More accurate REC reconstruction need not improve continuation. Building on this, we propose Hybrid State Transfer (HST) for all three state types. It uses structured REC maps and preserves history order during Conv alignment. We calibrate the adapters using the frozen tar

translated_title: 超越K/V缓存：混合线性注意力大语言模型中的跨模型状态交接
translated_abstract: 生产环境的部署通常通过级联、路由以及在长对话过程中切换不同模型来平衡成本与质量。上下文会随对话轮次不断累积，而每次模型切换都要求目标模型对已有上下文重新执行预填充。现有方法只在模型之间传输全注意力（FA）的K/V缓存，但混合线性注意力模型还会保留循环状态（REC）和卷积历史（Conv）。Conv与REC之间的相互作用使跨模型状态迁移变得复杂：Conv的扰动会改变循环层中的键和值，进而改变REC的更新；Conv历史会被覆盖，但REC中的变化仍可能影响后续输出，因此更精确的REC重建并不一定能带来更好的续写效果。基于这一发现，我们提出了针对全部三种状态类型的混合状态迁移方法（HST），它使用结构化的REC映射，并在Conv对齐过程中保持历史顺序。我们使用冻结的目标模型对适配器进行校准……
tldr: 提出混合状态迁移方法HST，可跨越混合线性注意力大语言模型迁移全注意力K/V缓存、循环状态和卷积历史这三种状态，并揭示了卷积与循环状态相互作用的规律，从而避免模型切换时的重复预填充。
en_tdlr: Proposes Hybrid State Transfer (HST), which transfers all three state types—full-attention K/V caches, recurrent states, and convolution histories—across hybrid linear-attention LLMs while revealing the interplay between Conv and REC, thereby eliminating redundant prefill when switching models.
